extracted.name: Easy Homemade Pizza Sauce
extracted.description: This delicious Pizza Sauce recipe is made in minutes, with a few basic ingredients, and tastes way better than bottles sauce.
ingredient_lines: 28 ounce can crushed tomatoes (, preferably San Marzano tomatoes)
freshly ground black pepper (, to taste)
instruction_lines: Add oil to a saucepan over medium heat. Add remaining ingredients and stir well to combine. Simmer for at least 5-10 minutes, or up to 30.
Your homemade pizza sauce is ready to use and spread on pizza crust.
